headline: Quiet night, no fix: NY high 10-06 hit (locked 62-or-below at 0.99, observed 60); picks_agree is live and withholds today's bet (ours 88% on 65-or-below vs market 51% on 66-67), but its disagree shadows go untagged when the court is already shut.

findings.title: withheld() tags why='disagree' only when the court is open
findings.evidence: kalshi_daily.py withheld(): b = dict(b, why='disagree') only if gate_open(leg); shut legs (NY high eve: n 27, ret -0.091) still count disagree-day shadows in edge_court, contrary to 429edd6's stated intent

findings.evidence: kalshi_low_ny.json live misses 09-16 p .81, 09-19 p 1.00, 09-22 p .92; calib 0.9 bin said .968 happened .60 (n 5); live logloss 1.444 vs market .598; 10-06 lock 47-48 at .99 pending
